pairs.difference: A: the mortarboard floats tilted, wide and shallow, shifted slightly left, with the tassel breaking the right side. Its box height of 0.506 is below the real range. pattern: Generated cards still show the whole object, held safely inside the card and parked near the center, with similar clearance on every side. Real cards commit more: they move in closer, tilt, push the hero toward an edge or crop it (the lighthouse base, the Ferris wheel, the fan). Generated cards also add secondary accents: the moon, gravestones, an island with props, floating bubbles. These split the thumbnail read, and upright symmetric poses on a level floor band look static. Caveat: many subjects here share a horror theme, and that was a soft tie-breaker on the weak calls (p01, p05, p09). Composition alone is only modestly decisive except on p08, where B repeats the REAL lesson lighthouse.
